fields.notes:
This stuff is brilliant for cheese toasties.

The brand name is Kerrygold.

Be careful the seal is unbroken.

Often on offer! Can be stacked apart from the rest of the sugar in REWE supermarkets!

Don't buy caster sugar instead; it's much more expensive!
Buy the lower fat version only if absolutely necessary!
Don't count tinned beans or lentils; they go in tinned and jarred food!
Anything at all in a tin or a jar that doesn't already count as a savory or sweet treat
